parameters.query:
WITH targets AS (
  SELECT u.user_id, u.email FROM users u
  WHERE u.role='EMPLOYEE' AND u.status='ACTIVE'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM weekly_reports w WHERE w.user_id=u.user_id
     AND w.iso_year=EXTRACT(ISOYEAR FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int
     AND w.iso_week=EXTRACT(WEEK FROM CURRENT_DATE)::int
     AND w.status IN ('SUBMITTED','UNDER_REVIEW','APPROVED','LOCKED'))
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.user_id=u.user_id
     AND n.type='WEEKLY_REMINDER' AND n.created_at > now() - interval '12 hours')
)
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, message)
SELECT user_id, 'WEEKLY_REMINDER', 'Reminder: your weekly report for this week is not submitted yet.'
FROM targets
RETURNING user_id, message
